lines.en: Let's do an experiment. Will this coin float or sink?

text_en: You can make a rainbow at home with a simple experiment.
You need a glass of water, a sheet of white paper and a sunny window.
First, fill the glass with water.
Then put it on a table near the window, in the sunlight.
Next, put the white paper on the floor in front of the glass.
You should see the colours of the rainbow on the paper!
This happens because the water bends the light, and white light is made of many colours.
Record your result in your notebook.
